scenario_label: Illustrative 10-station uniform IoT stream (NOT official TPCx-IoT scale)
notes: All quantities in this policy are synthetic, pre-benchmark parameters, not observations.
Assume every station carries every one of 200 named sensors, synchronised sampling, and complete historical coverage.
Use both endpoints of each five-second window; source event timestamps are equally spaced from the scenario start.
Storage estimates are uncompressed logical proxies and ignore memtables, SSTable layout, tombstones, compaction, indexes and protocol IO.
CQL request counts represent generated request fanout, not network latency or physical disk reads.
TS3 needs a canonical source and a durable replay mechanism in complete deployments; no such system is proved here.
TS0 is retained as a baseline despite a structurally unbounded partition horizon.
Official Java-kit sensor predicate and aggregation semantics remain unverified.
